name: myst-listing
description: Collect items and display them as tables, galleries, summaries, or feeds.

scripts.build: bun build src/plugin.ts --outfile dist/plugin.mjs --target node --format esm
scripts.build:docs: bun run build && cd docs && bunx mystmd build --html
scripts.docs:live: bun run build && cd docs && bunx mystmd start
scripts.test: bun run build:docs && bunx vitest run
